name: convai-character-authoring
description: Create, edit, review and release Convai characters.

interface.longDescription: Author and manage conversational characters for general-audience games and virtual worlds on Convai. Sign in with your Convai account to inspect characters, create and edit backstories, voices, languages and narratives, compare drafts and released versions, release or roll back versions, and connect existing knowledge documents. You can also manage stored function definitions and external tool-server associations, and inspect character conversation history when requested. The skills require confirmation before writes. Connected capabilities may affect later character conversations. The plugin does not upload knowledge documents or execute function code.
defaultPrompt: List my Convai characters and summarize each one in a sentence.
Create a Convai character named Captain Mira, a retired starship pilot who runs a spaceport cafe.
What changed in my character's draft since the last released version?
